comparison.objective: Stabilize a free leaning panel by seating a physical stopper, then withdraw support; not commission an impact absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Panel support, stopper placement, and safe hand withdrawal rather than tool-mediated unlocking, fine adjustment, relocking, and cyclic observation.
comparison.success_condition: Pass a 0.6 N pull and two-second check; tilt/displacement failure latches zero, with an 18 mm safety limit reported. Candidate uses stroke, impact, rebound, overload, repeatability, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Both concern stability under load, but one tests bracing geometry and the other tests iterative damping calibration.
